about: Temiskaming Shores is a city at the head of Lake Timiskaming in northeastern Ontario, formed by amalgamating New Liskeard, Haileybury, and Dymond. Clay-belt farmland, a lakeshore downtown, and a bilingual service role on the Quebec border define the community. About 10,000 people live in Temiskaming Shores.
